description: §31.2 NEGATIVE — two db-touching (§12.2 T1, server-escalated) functions in a straight-line call chain `loadOwner -> loadPet` compile clean: server→server composition is legal (§13.4). The E-DG- family stays quiet — E-DG-001 is retired (S479). A call cycle is not rejected either: a cycle of calls is recursion, not a dependency cycle (§31.2), pinned by reactive/server-fn-mutual-recursion-clean. Incidental W-PROGRAM-SPA-INFERRED / W-SQL-ROW-UNTYPED ignored by superset.
rationale: §13.4: 'A server-escalated function MAY call another server-escalated function. Both execute in the same server handler context.' §31.2 (S479): 'A cycle of calls between functions — direct recursion, or mutual recursion such as two server functions that call each other (§13.4) — is recursion, not a dependency cycle. The compiler SHALL NOT reject it.' An acyclic call chain is a fortiori not rejected; the reactive-graph cycles that are errors each have their own code (§31.2), and E-DG-001 is retired (§34).
